question: Which state has the highest percentage of its geographical area covered by forests, as per IFSR, 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mizoram** has the highest percentage of its geographical area covered by forests, as per the India State of Forest Report (ISFR) 2019.
 
• According to the ISFR 2019, Mizoram has approximately **85.41%** of its total geographical area under forest cover.
